passage.title: Community Garden Schedule
passage.body:
Programa de Voluntariado Comunitario

Lunes: 9:00 a. m. - 12:00 p. m.
Miércoles: 2:00 p. m. - 5:00 p. m.
Viernes: 10:00 a. m. - 1:00 p. m.

Jardín comunitario: 123 Calle Verde

Contacto: María González, 555-1234

Todos son bienvenidos.

items.stem: What is the 'Programa de Voluntariado Comunitario'?
choices: A program to teach Spanish to speakers of other languages.
A program to teach children about wild animals.
A program to help people grow food in a shared space.
A program to clean up the local park.
items.explanation: The text mentions 'jardín comunitario', which means 'community garden'. The other options are not mentioned in the text.

passage.title: Fishing Permit Requirements
passage.body:
Zona de pesca autorizada.
Solo con permiso.
Permiso: $20.
Válido por: 1 año.
Edad mínima: 16 años.
Límite máximo: 10 peces por día.
Prohibido el uso de redes.
Respetar el medio ambiente.
Gracias por su colaboración.

items.stem: What is the Spanish phrase 'zona de pesca' referring to in the text?
choices: a place where you can eat fish
an area where you can fish
an area where you can't fish
a place where you can buy fish
items.explanation: The correct answer is 'an area where you can fish'. The text states 'Zona de pesca autorizada', which means 'Authorized fishing area'. The other choices do not match the context of the text.

passage.title: Apartment Availability
passage.body: Se alquila apartamento de un dormitorio, con cocina equipada y baño. El alquiler es de 300 euros al mes. Disponible a partir del 15 de octubre. Contactar al 555-1234.

items.stem: What is the monthly rent for the apartment?
items.explanation: The text states that the rent is 300 euros per month: “alquiler de 300 euros al mes”

items.stem: What is the main purpose of this notice?
choices: To advertise an apartment for rent
To invite people to a party
items.explanation: The notice is advertising an apartment for rent, providing details such as the rent amount and the availability date.

passage.title: Factory Relocation Notice
passage.body: Cierre de fábrica. La fábrica se trasladará a una nueva ubicación. El 30 de noviembre será el último día. Gracias por su apoyo. ¡Mucha suerte!

items.stem: What is the main idea of the notice?
choices: The factory is hiring new employees.
The factory is introducing a new product line.
The factory is moving to a new location.
The factory is changing its operating hours.
items.explanation: The main idea of the notice is that the factory is moving to a new location. This is explicitly stated in the text: “La fábrica se muda a una nueva ubicación.”

passage.title: New Peacekeeping Mission Announcement
passage.body: ¡Atención, ciudadanos! Nuestra ciudad está organizando una misión de mantenimiento de la paz para ayudar en el país vecino de Verdemar. La misión comenzará el próximo mes y durará seis meses. Estamos buscando voluntarios para unirse a nuestro equipo. Si te interesa ayudar a mantener la paz en Verdemar, por favor contáctanos. Juntos, podemos marcar la diferencia. ¡Gracias por tu apoyo!

items.stem: What is the main idea of this notice?
choices: The city council is organizing a peacekeeping mission to a nearby country.
The city council is asking for donations to support a local school.
The city council is announcing a new policy for city security.
The city council is requesting volunteers to help with a local community event.
items.explanation: The main idea of the notice is that the city council is organizing a peacekeeping mission to a nearby country. This is evident from the phrases 'misión de mantenimiento de la paz' and 'nuestra ciudad está organizando una misión de mantenimiento de la paz para ayudar en el país vecino de Verdemar'.

items.stem: What is the name of the country that the mission will help?
items.explanation: The name of the country that the mission will help is Verdemar. This is stated in the text as 'nuestra ciudad está organizando una misión de mantenimiento de la paz para ayudar en el país vecino de Verdemar'.

items.stem: What does 'pacífico' mean in this context?
items.explanation: In this context, 'pacífico' means 'peaceful'. The text states that the mission will help maintain peace in Verdemar, 'para ayudar a mantener la paz en Verdemar'.

passage.title: Debate Announcement
passage.body: El club de debate invita a todos a discutir sobre el servicio militar en la actualidad. La reunión será el próximo viernes a las 7 de la tarde en el auditorio de la universidad. Todos están invitados a asistir y compartir sus opiniones. Ven y participa en esta importante discusión. ¡Te esperamos!

items.stem: What is the main topic of the debate?
choices: The current state of military service
items.explanation: The text states "discutiremos el servicio militar en la actualidad", which translates to "we will discuss military service in the present day." This indicates that the main topic of the debate is the current state of military service.

items.stem: In the text, what does "asistir" mean?
items.explanation: The text says "Todos están invitados a asistir", which means "Everyone is invited to attend." This shows that "asistir" means "to attend" in this context.

passage.title: Water Outage Warning
passage.body: Comunicamos una interrupción del servicio de agua debido a un ciberataque. El suministro de agua estará suspendido durante 24 horas. Por favor, utilicen el agua con moderación durante este período. Lamentamos las molestias que esto pueda ocasionar. Manténganse informados a través de nuestra página web y redes sociales para obtener actualizaciones.

items.stem: What caused the water outage?
items.explanation: The text states that the water outage was caused by 'un ciberataque', which means a cyberattack. This is clearly mentioned in the announcement.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
choices: To warn about a water outage due to a cyberattack.
To announce a planned water main replacement.
To schedule a routine inspection of the water system.
To inform about a new water rate increase.
items.explanation: The main purpose of the announcement is to warn about a water outage. The text says 'Avisamos un corte de agua debido a un ciberataque', which clearly indicates that the announcement is about informing the public of a water outage caused by a cyberattack.

items.stem: What does the phrase 'el servicio de agua' mean here?
items.explanation: In this context, 'el servicio de agua' refers to the water supply system. The text mentions 'problemas con el servicio de agua', indicating issues with the water supply system due to the cyberattack.

passage.title: Summer Water Restrictions
passage.body: El Ayuntamiento informa que, debido a la sequía del verano, habrá restricciones en el uso del agua. A partir del 1 de julio, no se podrá lavar coches ni llenar piscinas entre las 10:00 y las 18:00 horas. Estas medidas se mantendrán hasta nuevo aviso. Agradecemos su colaboración para evitar el desperdicio de agua. Ayuntamiento.

items.stem: The announcement states that the restrictions will affect the use of water for:
items.explanation: The correct answer is "washing cars and filling pools," because the text states that these activities are restricted from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. It does not mention restrictions on drinking, cooking, indoor cleaning, or laundry. The relevant words are "lavar coches y llenar piscinas."

items.stem: The main purpose of this announcement is to:
choices: announce water restrictions due to summer shortages
promote water conservation tips for residents
inform residents about a new water park opening
items.explanation: The correct answer is "announce water restrictions due to summer shortages," because the text explicitly states that there will be restrictions on water use during certain hours. It does not mention a new water park, flooding, or water conservation tips. The relevant words are "habrá restricciones en el uso del agua" and "por la sequía del verano."

passage.title: A New Rocket
passage.body:
Querido Juan,

Ayer asistí al despegue del nuevo cohete. ¡Fue muy emocionante! El cohete era grande y brillante. Todos gritamos cuando despegó. Fue genial.

Espero que puedas ver el próximo despegue conmigo.

Tu amigo,
Luis

items.stem: What does the writer say about the launch?
items.explanation: The writer says the launch was emocionante (exciting). The other choices are not mentioned in the text.

items.stem: What does the writer mean by 'despegue'?
items.explanation: The writer uses 'despegue' to refer to the moment when the rocket leaves the ground, which is a rocket taking off. The other choices are not what 'despegue' means in this context.

passage.title: New Subsidy Program for Small Businesses
passage.body: El gobierno ha aprobado un nuevo programa de subvenciones para pequeñas empresas que deseen adquirir equipos energéticamente eficientes. Este programa tiene como objetivo reducir el consumo de energía y promover el uso de tecnologías sostenibles. La subvención cubrirá el 40% del coste de los equipos, siempre y cuando cumplan con los estándares de eficiencia establecidos. Las empresas interesadas deben presentar una solicitud antes del 30 de noviembre de este año. Los fondos serán otorgados por orden de llegada hasta que se agoten los recursos disponibles. Se recomienda a las empresas que se informen sobre los requisitos específicos y los plazos de presentación en la página web del Ministerio de Energía.

items.stem: What is the main point of the text?
choices: Small businesses are required to report their energy usage every month.
Small businesses can receive subsidies for energy-efficient equipment.
Small businesses will be fined if they do not switch to renewable energy sources.
Small businesses must reduce their energy consumption by a certain percentage.
items.explanation: The text states that "el gobierno ha aprobado un nuevo programa de subsidios" (the government has approved a new subsidy program) for small businesses to "adquirir equipos energéticamente eficientes" (purchase energy-efficient equipment). This is the main point of the text.

items.stem: What percentage of the cost of energy-efficient equipment will the subsidy cover?
items.explanation: The text specifies that "el subsidio cubrirá el 40% del costo de los equipos" (the subsidy will cover 40% of the cost of the equipment).

items.stem: In the phrase "equipos energéticamente eficientes," what does "energéticamente" mean?
items.explanation: In this context, "energéticamente" refers to the energy efficiency of the equipment, meaning "in terms of energy." The text is discussing equipment that uses energy efficiently, not necessarily equipment that uses a lot of energy, produces energy, or is related to energy prices.
